_about: Outlets tracked by Obe strane. 'camp' is the outlet's starting label, based on published media monitoring (CRTA, BIRN Media Ownership Monitor, Raskrikavanje) and editorial review. It is a hypothesis to review, not a verdict. 'group' is only used to organise the Izvori page. 'feed' is optional: without it the collector finds the feed on the homepage, or reads headlines from the homepage itself. Only pro_government vs critical counts for blindspots; international outlets are shown but never count for either side. 'owner' is checked against the linked source (owner_src), last reviewed November 2026. 'paused' outlets are listed but not fetched.
